chapterInfo.content:
8
Wɔde Asiriahene bɛtwe ɔman no aso
1Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Fa twerɛpono kɛseɛ, na fa ɔdasani twerɛdua twerɛ so sɛ: Maher-salal-has-bas.#8.1 MAHER-SALAL-HAS-BAS: Asekyerɛ ne: Ntɛm-so-asadeɛ-ɛherɛ-so-fom. 2Na mɛma adansefoɔ anokwafoɔ, Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria ne Yeberekia ba Sakaria adi me adanseɛ. 3Na mekɔɔ odiyifoɔbaa#8.3 ODIYIFOƆBAA: Odiyifoɔbaa no yɛ Yesaia yere. no ho, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Frɛ ne din sɛ: Maher-salal-has-bas. 4#Yes 7.16; 2 Ah 16.9; 15.29 Na abarimaa no nnya nhunuu agya anaa ɛna frɛ no, wɔbɛsoa Damasko ahoɔden ne Samaria asadeɛ adi Asiriahene anim akɔ.
5Na AWURADE toaa so ka kyerɛɛ me bio sɛ: 6#Yes 30.15 Ɛsiane sɛ ɔman yi bu Siloa nsuo a ɛsene brɛɛ animtia na wɔn ho sane wɔn Resin ne Remalia ba no ho nti, 7hwɛ, AWURADE de asubɔnten no mu nsuo a ano yɛ den na ɛdɔɔso no reba wɔn so, Asiriahene ne n’animuonyam nyinaa; na ɛbɛba abɛforo ne suka nyinaa, na ayiri akata ne nsunoa nyinaa; 8#Yes 7.14 na ɛbɛsene afa Yuda mu ayiri akɔduru kɔn mu, na ne ntaban mu trɛ aduru w’asase ano, O Imanuel.
9 # Dwom 2 Aman, monka mo ho mmoa ano, na monnwerɛ ara,
asase a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri sofoɔ nyinaa, monyɛ aso,
mommia na monnwerɛ,
mommia na monnwerɛ.
10 # Yes 8.8 Montu agyina na ɛbɛyɛ ɔkwa,
monka asɛm na ɛrennyina,
ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn ne yɛn wɔ hɔ.
Nyankopɔn mu gyidie ho kɔkɔbɔ
11Na sɛɛ na AWURADE de nsa denden ka kyerɛɛ me, na ɔde teaa me sɛ mennante ɔman yi kwan so sɛ: 12Mommfrɛ adeɛ a ɔman no frɛ no etiresopam no nyinaa sɛ etiresopam, na deɛ wɔsuro nso monnsuro, na mo akoma nntu. 13#Yes 29.23; Mat 10.28; 1 Pe 3.15 Asafo AWURADE no, ɔno na monyɛ no kronkron, na ɔno na ɔnyɛ mo suro ne mo akomatuo. 14#Yes 28.16; Rom 9.33; 1 Pe 2.7-8 Na ɔbɛyɛ kronkronbea, nso ɔbɛyɛ suntiboɔ ne ɔwatiri botan ama Israel afie mmienu no nyinaa, na wayɛ kantankoraa ne fidie ama wɔn nyinaa, na wayɛ kantankoraa ne fidie ama wɔn a wɔte Yerusalem no. 15Na wɔn mu bebree bɛwatiri, na wɔahwehwe ase na wɔabubu, na wɔatotɔ mfidie mu na wɔayiyi wɔn.
16Kyekyere adanseɛ no, sɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ no ano m’asuafoɔ mu. 17Na mɛtwɛn AWURADE a ɔyi n’ani hunta Yakob fie no, na m’ani da ne so. 18#Heb 2.13; Yes 7.3; 8.3 Hwɛ, me ne me mma a AWURADE ama me sɛ yɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ Israel mu no firi asafo AWURADE a ɔte Sion bepɔ soɔ no. 19#2 Ah 1.3 Na sɛ wɔka kyerɛ mo sɛ: Mommisa asamanfrɛfoɔ ne adunsinfoɔ a wɔde nnomaa su ne asutuo kasa no a, ɛnyɛ ɔman no Nyankopɔn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbisa ne hɔ adeɛ anaa? Awufoɔ hɔ na wɔmmisa adeɛ mma ateasefoɔ? 20Wɔnni mmara ne adanseɛ no akyi! Sɛ wɔanka no sɛdeɛ asɛm yi teɛ a, ɛnneɛ adeɛ renkye wɔn. 21#Adi 16.9, 11 Na wɔbɛfa asase no mu akɔ, na ayɛ den ama wɔn na ɛkɔm ade wɔn; na ɛberɛ a ɛkɔm rede wɔn no, wɔn ho bɛyera wɔn, na wɔadome wɔn hene ne wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔadanedane wɔn ani akyerɛ soro, 22#Yes 5.30 na wɔahwɛ fam nso; nanso hwɛ, ahohiahia ne sum nie, ahodwan kusuuyɛ, na wɔasum wɔn agu sum kabii mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Fa twerɛpono kɛseɛ, na fa ɔdasani twerɛdua twerɛ so sɛ: Maher-salal-has-bas. Na mɛma adansefoɔ anokwafoɔ, Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria ne Yeberekia ba Sakaria adi me adanseɛ. Na mekɔɔ odiyifoɔbaa no ho, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Frɛ ne din sɛ: Maher-salal-has-bas. Na abarimaa no nnya nhunuu agya anaa ɛna frɛ no, wɔbɛsoa Damasko ahoɔden ne Samaria asadeɛ adi Asiriahene anim akɔ.
Na AWURADE toaa so ka kyerɛɛ me bio sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ ɔman yi bu Siloa nsuo a ɛsene brɛɛ animtia na wɔn ho sane wɔn Resin ne Remalia ba no ho nti, hwɛ, AWURADE de asubɔnten no mu nsuo a ano yɛ den na ɛdɔɔso no reba wɔn so, Asiriahene ne n’animuonyam nyinaa; na ɛbɛba abɛforo ne suka nyinaa, na ayiri akata ne nsunoa nyinaa; na ɛbɛsene afa Yuda mu ayiri akɔduru kɔn mu, na ne ntaban mu trɛ aduru w’asase ano, O Imanuel.
Aman, monka mo ho mmoa ano, na monnwerɛ ara,
asase a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri sofoɔ nyinaa, monyɛ aso,
mommia na monnwerɛ,
mommia na monnwerɛ.
Montu agyina na ɛbɛyɛ ɔkwa,
monka asɛm na ɛrennyina,
ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn ne yɛn wɔ hɔ.

Na sɛɛ na AWURADE de nsa denden ka kyerɛɛ me, na ɔde teaa me sɛ mennante ɔman yi kwan so sɛ: Mommfrɛ adeɛ a ɔman no frɛ no etiresopam no nyinaa sɛ etiresopam, na deɛ wɔsuro nso monnsuro, na mo akoma nntu. Asafo AWURADE no, ɔno na monyɛ no kronkron, na ɔno na ɔnyɛ mo suro ne mo akomatuo. Na ɔbɛyɛ kronkronbea, nso ɔbɛyɛ suntiboɔ ne ɔwatiri botan ama Israel afie mmienu no nyinaa, na wayɛ kantankoraa ne fidie ama wɔn nyinaa, na wayɛ kantankoraa ne fidie ama wɔn a wɔte Yerusalem no. Na wɔn mu bebree bɛwatiri, na wɔahwehwe ase na wɔabubu, na wɔatotɔ mfidie mu na wɔayiyi wɔn.
Kyekyere adanseɛ no, sɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ no ano m’asuafoɔ mu. Na mɛtwɛn AWURADE a ɔyi n’ani hunta Yakob fie no, na m’ani da ne so. Hwɛ, me ne me mma a AWURADE ama me sɛ yɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ Israel mu no firi asafo AWURADE a ɔte Sion bepɔ soɔ no. Na sɛ wɔka kyerɛ mo sɛ: Mommisa asamanfrɛfoɔ ne adunsinfoɔ a wɔde nnomaa su ne asutuo kasa no a, ɛnyɛ ɔman no Nyankopɔn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbisa ne hɔ adeɛ anaa? Awufoɔ hɔ na wɔmmisa adeɛ mma ateasefoɔ? Wɔnni mmara ne adanseɛ no akyi! Sɛ wɔanka no sɛdeɛ asɛm yi teɛ a, ɛnneɛ adeɛ renkye wɔn. Na wɔbɛfa asase no mu akɔ, na ayɛ den ama wɔn na ɛkɔm ade wɔn; na ɛberɛ a ɛkɔm rede wɔn no, wɔn ho bɛyera wɔn, na wɔadome wɔn hene ne wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔadanedane wɔn ani akyerɛ soro, na wɔahwɛ fam nso; nanso hwɛ, ahohiahia ne sum nie, ahodwan kusuuyɛ, na wɔasum wɔn agu sum kabii mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
